name: @erkasa/gate
description: Validation Gate (E1.3): decides whether an erkasa.render/1 package may be rendered. Checks everything the JSON Schema cannot: the pinned manifest, files inside the asset root, approvals, builtins against the engine's published capabilities, references, states, parameters, tracks, times, holders and budgets. Depends only on @erkasa/contracts; the engine's capabilities come in as data.
